title: State Department UAP Cable 5, Mexico, September 16, 2003
doc_notes: This is a State Department cable summarizing political events in Mexico, including a brief report on a congressional hearing regarding UAP and alleged alien remains.

encounters.summary: Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan presented two alleged alien corpses to the Mexican Congress during a hearing on UAP, which were subsequently discredited by scientists.
encounters.quote: Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan presented the alleged remains of non-human beings to Congress.
